description: This Java source file defines a Fragment called RecyclerViewFragment that demonstrates the use of Android's RecyclerView with different layout managers (LinearLayoutManager and GridLayoutManager). It manages dataset initialization, layout switching via radio buttons, and preserves state across configuration changes.

classes.name: RecyclerViewFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating the setup and dynamic switching of RecyclerView layouts using LinearLayoutManager and GridLayoutManager. Manages dataset generation, layout switching, and state preservation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the fragment is created; initializes dataset.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view, initializes RecyclerView, adapters, and layout switch buttons, and restores previous state if available.

methods.name: setRecyclerViewLayoutManager
methods.description: Sets the RecyclerView's layout manager to either linear or grid based on the specified type, preserving scroll position.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current layout manager type to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: initDataset
methods.description: Populates the dataset array with string elements for the RecyclerView.
